title: Chinese Dry-Fried Green Beans with Garlic and Chilli
summary: A vegan Chinese-style green bean dish with blistered, smoky beans tossed in fragrant garlic, ginger, chilli and soy sauce. Serve it with rice or tofu for a quick, punchy dinner.
steps: Pat the green beans very dry with a clean tea towel; this helps them blister rather than steam.

Heat a large wok or frying pan over high heat until very hot. Add the vegetable oil, then the green beans and salt. Stir-fry for 8–10 minutes, tossing often, until the beans are wrinkled, blistered in places and tender-crisp.
Reduce the heat to medium. Add the garlic, ginger, chilli and the white parts of the spring onions. Stir-fry for 1–2 minutes until fragrant, taking care not to burn the garlic.
Add the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar and black pepper. Toss for 1 minute until the beans are glossy and the sauce has mostly evaporated.
Turn off the heat and stir through the sesame oil and remaining spring onions. Serve hot as part of a Chinese-style dinner.
